name: deutschle
description: A mobile-first German vocabulary word guessing game inspired by Wordle. The visual foundation includes a dark, mobile-first shell, a 5 × 6 board, and a German keyboard. Physical and virtual keyboards enter up to five letters per row; Backspace deletes from the current row. Enter locks a complete five-letter guess and advances to the next row. Input stops after six submitted guesses. Submitted guesses are evaluated with duplicate-aware letter matching and lime, purple, or dark gray tiles. Input and game state live in `src/hooks/useGame.ts`.

scripts.build: npm run validate:data && npm run typecheck && vite build
